Title: Power BI Embedded integration with Azure Diagnostics

Body.Content:
Power BI Embedded integration with Azure Diagnostics logs is now available. Azure Diagnostics log events can help you dive into specific behaviors of the resource and better understand root causes for any peaks in usage or errors that occurred.

With Diagnostics, you can log many events from your capacity, pour them into any analytics tool, and get insights on the behavior of your resource. We added a built-in integration that help you store the events in a storage account in Azure, stream them to an event hub, or analyze them in Azure Log Analytics. Learn more.
